clauses.clause: Obliterating Bolt deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
clauses.evidence: Target slot: the six creatures (no players, no other permanents; no planeswalker on the probe board); each target is dealt 4 damage. Pack obliterating_bolt_3: a planeswalker (Liliana, Dreadhorde General) is a legal target.

clauses.clause: If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
clauses.evidence: Every target (1/1 to 4/4) moves battlefield -> exile, never to a graveyard. Pack obliterating_bolt_1: a 6/6 target survives the 4 and dies later that turn: exiled; another creature dying that turn goes to the graveyard. obliterating_bolt_2: the 6/6 dies the next turn: graveyard. obliterating_bolt_3: a planeswalker at 3 loyalty is exiled.
